news.headline: AI Bubble About to Burst? Top Tech Investor Warns Most Neocloud Players Could Go to Zero
news.summary: Midterm results trigger a $3.2T tech market selloff. Analysts assess the fallout for NVIDIA, hyperscalers, and neocloud infrastructure.

news.headline: Chip Stocks Just Had Their Worst Day Since 2020: 28 of 30 Biggest Names Are in a Bear Market
